2026-09-03.english_html:
📖 30天趣味记忆·第1篇
第1篇：The Ant and the Grasshopper In a sunny meadow, a diligent ant toiled each day, storing grain for the coming winter. A carefree grasshopper sang and mocked the ant's labor. When snow covered the field, the grasshopper shivered with hunger, while the ant enjoyed a warm, full burrow. The grasshopper learned that foresight and hard work are essential for survival. This ancient fable reminds us: today's preparation is tomorrow's security. 中文翻译：在一个阳光明媚的草地上，一只勤奋的蚂蚁每天辛劳，为即将到来的冬天储存粮食。一只无忧无虑的蚱蜢唱歌并嘲笑蚂蚁的劳动。当雪覆盖田野时，蚱蜢因饥饿而颤抖，而蚂蚁享受着温暖而充实的洞穴。蚱蜢明白了远见和勤奋是生存的关键。这个古老的寓言提醒我们：今天的准备是明天的安全。 重点词汇：diligent (勤奋的), toil (辛劳), store (储存), mock (嘲笑), shiver (颤抖), foresight (远见), essential (必要的), fable (寓言), preparation (准备), security (安全)
✅ 每日自测
中译英：1. 勤奋的蚂蚁每天储存粮食。2. 蚱蜢嘲笑蚂蚁的劳动。3. 远见和勤奋是生存的关键。 英译中：1. A carefree grasshopper sang and mocked the ant's labor. 2. When snow covered the field, the grasshopper shivered with hunger. 3. Today's preparation is tomorrow's security. 填空：1. The ant ______ grain for the coming winter. (store的适当形式) 2. The grasshopper learned that ______ and hard work are essential. (根据文章填词)

2026-09-04.english_html:
📖 30天趣味记忆·第2篇
第2篇：The Persistent Gardener Tom, an elderly gardener, faced a severe drought. His neighbors abandoned their plots, but he dug deeper wells and watered his plants at dawn. He believed that every seed held a promise. Months later, his garden bloomed while others lay barren. His persistence not only fed his family but also inspired the village to cooperate. They built a shared irrigation system, turning despair into abundance. Tom taught them that patience and effort can transform even the harshest conditions. 中文翻译：执着的园丁 老园丁汤姆面临严重干旱。邻居们放弃了土地，但他挖了更深的井，在黎明时给植物浇水。他相信每颗种子都蕴含希望。几个月后，他的花园繁花似锦，而其他土地荒芜。他的坚持不仅养活了家人，还激励了全村合作。他们建起共享灌溉系统，将绝望变为丰饶。汤姆教会他们，耐心和努力能改变最艰苦的环境。 重点词汇：persistent (执着的), drought (干旱), abandon (放弃), plot (小块土地), irrigation (灌溉), abundance (丰饶), harsh (严酷的)
✅ 每日自测
中译英：1. 他相信每颗种子都蕴含希望。2. 他的坚持激励了全村合作。3. 耐心和努力能改变最艰苦的环境。 英译中：1. His neighbors abandoned their plots. 2. They built a shared irrigation system. 3. Turning despair into abundance. 填空：1. Tom ____ an elderly gardener, faced a severe ____. (答案：was, drought) 2. His ____ not only fed his family but also ____ the village. (答案：persistence, inspired)
